visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at night outside Tokyo Station, featuring the prominent illuminated JR Tokyo Station sign. A black taxi is parked in the foreground, and shrubs line the sidewalk. (2) The view shifts to a promotional poster inside the station, showing a woman in a pink outfit holding a suitcase, advertising the 'Touch de Go!' service for Shinkansen. (3) A close-up shows a green 'Touch de Go!' sticker on a JR East ticket machine. (4) A person's hand places an iPhone with a mountain wallpaper onto the IC card reader of the ticket machine. (5) The hand interacts with the touchscreen, selecting the green button labeled 'タッチでGO! 新幹線' in the bottom right corner. (6) The camera captures the screen showing registration instructions; the hand presses '利用開始登録に進む' in the bottom left. (7) A sequence of screens explaining the service area and terms are shown. The person presses '次の画面' (Next Screen) at the bottom right multiple times to proceed. (8) The final confirmation screen is reached, and a registration receipt is printed from the machine. (9) The person holds the small white printed slip, which displays registration details and the date. (10) The video ends with a pink graphic logo for 'Japanuts' and various social media icons and handles.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: JR 東京駅 Tokyo Station. [Subtitle]: 你知道嗎？用西瓜卡就能搭新幹線. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. (2) [Subtitle]: 日本近期一直推廣用西瓜卡綁定就能搭新幹線. (3) [Subtitle]: 綁定方式超簡單，用售票機就可以，有些旁邊還剛好有標示. (4) [Subtitle]: 把實體西瓜卡或手機西瓜卡放到機器感應位置上. (5) [Subtitle]: 按下右下角綠色的「タッチでGO! 新幹線」. (6) [Subtitle]: 接著按左下角「利用開始登錄に進む」. (7) [Subtitle]: 然後看一下說明部分，再按右下角「次の畫面」. (8) [Subtitle]: 最後按登錄完了，就完成綁定. (9) [Subtitle]: 用西瓜卡綁定後，如果刷西瓜卡進站搭新幹線，是只能搭「自由席」喔. (10) [Subtitle]: 對於只搭幾站或是來不及買票的人，還滿方便的. (11) [Subtitle]: 提供你們參考參考. (12) [Slogan]: 看更多資訊請點IG首頁連結 japanuts.com. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋俱樂部 @japanuts. [Variety]: 按讚 留言 分享.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a clear, step-by-step tutorial for travelers in Japan on how to register their Suica or mobile IC cards for the 'Touch de Go!' service, allowing them to ride the Shinkansen using their IC card balance for unreserved seats.
